nhl.xg_for.rationale: NEWS:report is spurious (the word 'report' in the measurement text 'report adjusted rates'); nothing here needs timestamped news. xGF/60 is built from nhl.shots_xy (MoneyPuck xGoal) plus team_states, all EVENT_TIME, so PIT_UNAVAILABLE_HISTORICALLY is wrong.

nhl.xg_against.rationale: PROJECTIONS:projection is spurious (own 'lineup-weighted projection', not an external projection vintage) but the lineup-weighted variant does need pregame absent-defenceman info; draft mapped LINEUP to blocked shift charts instead of pregame availability vintages (nhl.lineup_goalie_pregame/nhl.injuries exist from 2026-10 only). Core xGA/60 from nhl.shots_xy is fine.
nhl.xg_against.notes: Team xGA core is PIT-safe; only the absent-defencemen adjustment needs timestamped lineup vintages.

nhl.pace.rationale: DRAFT:combine is spurious: it matched the word 'combined' in 'Combined Corsi attempts'; PLAYER_BOX:scorer also incidental. Attempt rates come from nhl.shots_xy attempts and team_states TOI, both EVENT_TIME, so the PIT_UNAVAILABLE verdict is wrong.

nhl.special_teams.rationale: DRAFT:combine is spurious (verb 'combine as expected PP goals'). The definition does need 'replace personnel when key unit members out' = pregame availability, plus PP minutes from penalties; draft had no AVAIL need and shots_xy has no penalty events.
nhl.special_teams.notes: PP/PK xG rates are PIT-safe; personnel replacement needs lineup vintages.

nhl.goalie_start.rationale: AVAIL was satisfied by nhl.goalie_games, whose starter flag is FINAL_ONLY (registry: pregame confirmation time not recorded); a timestamped confirmed starter exists only in nhl.lineup_goalie_pregame (probe archive from 2026-10, LIVE_SNAPSHOT). Draft pit verdict is correct but the dataset chosen is the wrong one.

nhl.lines.rationale: Definition scrapes projected lines at several pre-game times and compares to realized shifts: needs timestamped pregame line vintages (nhl.lineup_goalie_pregame, from 2026-10 only) plus shift charts (blocked). Draft maps only the blocked shift-chart dataset and calls PIT_SAFE.

nhl.toi.rationale: Projected TOI 'conditioned on lineup (who is in/out)' needs pregame availability, which draft never mapped; TOI by EV/PP/SH is already in nhl.player_games so the blocked shift-chart dataset is not required for rates. Draft COMPUTED_FULL/PIT_SAFE overstates.

nhl.pp_role.rationale: DRAFT:combine spurious ('combine with player PP shot'). PP1/PP2 unit assignment comes from shift charts (nhl.shifts_lines, blocked); nhl.player_games has only toi_pp_s totals, and shooter/net-front role needs shot x,y; a pregame projected unit needs lineup vintages.

nhl.assist_rate.rationale: Primary/secondary assists per 60 at EV and PP separately: player_games a1/a2 are not split by strength (only gf_ev/gf_pp), so strength-split assists need goal events with assisters (NHL pbp, not in registry); linemate conditioning needs shift charts (blocked). Draft COMPUTED_FULL with blocked LINEUP is inconsistent.

nhl.injuries_pit.rationale: AVAIL mapped to nhl.goalie_games (goalie rows only, FINAL_ONLY) cannot supply skater injury/scratch status; the real data class is nhl.injuries (LIVE_SNAPSHOT, no history endpoint) and nhl.lineup_goalie_pregame (from 2026-10). PLAYER_BOX:snap is spurious (matched 'snapshot'). History is unavailable, not merely leaky.

nhl.venue.rationale: WEATHER_OBS:altitude is spurious for indoor arenas: altitude is a static field in env.venue_geo and env.weather_observed is blocked and irrelevant. Rink counting-bias fixed effects come from nhl.shots_xy by home team.

nhl.score_state.rationale: NEWS:report (word 'report adjusted rates'), VENUE:neutral and MARKET_RULES:void are all keyword accidents, which wrongly force COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE/PIT_UNAVAILABLE. It is a simulation over pregame win probability and total, so it depends on rating/script inputs; raw need is shot events with score state.

nhl.ot_so.rationale: Definition is a model (bivariate tie probability, 3v3 rates, shootout talent): list upstream inputs. Also needs Kalshi rules text for whether OT/SO counts (m.rules_text); draft RULES->xx.rules_reference is the NHL rulebook, not contract wording.

nhl.empty_net.rationale: Per-coach pull-time distribution needs coach identity/tenure (no coaching dataset in registry) and exact pull times; team_states only has sec_ea seconds. Also needs contract wording on empty-net goals (Kalshi rules text).

nhl.award_stats.rationale: NEWS:narrative and PROJECTIONS:projection are spurious: the rate projection is own EWMA computation, not an external projection vintage; 'narrative' is a modelling covariate. Real needs: player/team season stats and historical award results. Depends on games-played hazard for games remaining.

nhl.officials.rationale: EVENT 'penalt' mapped to nhl.shots_xy, which holds shot events only (no penalty events); penalty calls need NHL play-by-play penalty events (not in registry). Referee assignments dataset is NO_FREE_SOURCE so BLOCKED stands.

nhl.shots_against.rationale: Definition says 'project for the specific lineup (missing defencemen)': needs pregame absence info, which draft mapped to blocked shift charts instead of availability vintages. Base SOGA/60 from shots_xy is PIT-safe.

nhl.penalty_rates.rationale: Penalties taken/drawn per 60 need penalty events (taker/drawer, time): nhl.shots_xy has none and player_games has only pim minutes; crew tendencies need referee data (NO_FREE_SOURCE).

nhl.onice_shpct.rationale: PROJECTIONS:projection is spurious (own regression). On-ice xGF per player requires attributing each shot's xG to the skaters on ice: shots_xy carries only the shooter, so shift charts (nhl.shifts_lines, blocked) are needed. player_games gf_ev/att_ev are on-ice counts, not xG.

nhl.dman_shot_profile.rationale: raw_data lists zone start/faceoff location and PP unit assignment: faceoffs are not in shots_xy (shot events only) and PP units need shift charts (blocked). Draft mapped everything to shots_xy/player_games.

nhl.linemate_quality.rationale: Projecting 'with confirmed lines' needs pregame confirmed-lines vintages (nhl.lineup_goalie_pregame, from 2026-10) on top of shift charts; RAPM here is own regression from shifts (RATINGS_EXT->shots_xy mapping is wrong). Draft PIT_SAFE is optimistic.

nhl.last_change_matchups.rationale: Head-to-head TOI shares between opposing lines/pairs come from shift charts (nhl.shifts_lines, FREE_BLOCKED_FROM_RUNNER); draft mapped only shots_xy/player_games and declared DATA_IN_HAND. Neither contains opposing-line overlap.

nhl.pk_structure_opp.rationale: DRAFT:combine ('combine with the player's PP shot role') and PLAYER_BOX:share are spurious; PK SOGA/xGA/shot-location come from nhl.shots_xy strength-split rows and team_states, EVENT_TIME.

nhl.goalie_start_forecast.rationale: raw_data requires morning-skate/reporter starter reports with timestamps and goalie injury reports: AVAIL was satisfied by nhl.goalie_games (FINAL_ONLY starter flag). Needs nhl.lineup_goalie_pregame/nhl.injuries (LIVE_SNAPSHOT, from 2026-10) and xx.news_timestamped.
nhl.goalie_start_forecast.notes: Rest-pattern part of the forecast is computable from goalie_games; timestamped reports are prospective only.

nhl.morning_skate_signal.rationale: Needs beat-writer line/goalie reports with timestamps: dataset is nhl.lineup_goalie_pregame and xx.news_timestamped, not shift charts. EVENT:first goal and PLAYER_BOX:goalie are spurious matches.

nhl.injury_return_ramp.rationale: AVAIL 'injur' mapped to nhl.goalie_games (goalie rows only, final); skater injury/return status exists only in nhl.injuries (LIVE_SNAPSHOT, no history). Games-since-return can be proxied from player_games gaps, so COMPUTED_PROXY, but pregame return knowledge has no vintages.

nhl.callup_depth.rationale: Replacement-level value from 'AHL-to-NHL data': no AHL dataset in registry; call-ups/scratches 'timestamped' need transaction log and lineup vintages, but AVAIL was mapped to nhl.goalie_games (goalies only, final).
nhl.callup_depth.notes: AHL statistics are absent from the registry; treat as a further gap.

nhl.game_script_prob.rationale: Definition derives lead/trail probabilities from team ratings (and the market line): derived input with upstream nhl.ratings; the optional market-line component must be excluded to stay market-free.
nhl.game_script_prob.notes: Market-line component is benchmark-only; the ratings-only version is the market-free variant.

nhl.coach_deployment_style.rationale: Measurement needs line-level TOI shares (top-line EV share, line shuffle rate, PP1 share) = shift/line charts (blocked), and coach start dates for decay; draft used only period/TOI box data and mapped coach change to transactions.

nhl.standings_stakes.rationale: AVAIL:status is spurious ('clinch status'); RATINGS_EXT:rapm is own rating computation, not external. Clinch/elimination standings are derived from game results and tiebreak rules; deadline trades need the transaction log.

nhl.playoff_context.rationale: raw measurement needs TOI by line position (shift/line charts, blocked) and penalties per game (penalty events not in shots_xy/player_games, only pim). Draft DATA_IN_HAND is optimistic.

nhl.reg_tie_model.rationale: Measurement is a Dixon-Coles/bivariate Poisson fit with goalie and empty-net terms: derived from goalie_quality, empty_net, xg_for/xg_against; status must be capped by upstream inputs.

nhl.first_goal_hazard.rationale: VENUE:home advantage is spurious (home flag comes from nhl.games); it forced COLLECT_FREE_UNVERIFIED via unprobed venue_geo. Needs first-goal times from shots_xy and goalie quality input.

nhl.opening_shift_deployment.rationale: Starting five and first-5-minute line deployment need shift charts (blocked) and faceoff events (not in shots_xy); 'update when lineup changes' needs lineup vintages. AVAIL was mapped to goalie_games, which has none of this.

nhl.zone_start_share.rationale: OZ start% needs faceoff/zone-start events (not in shots_xy) and QoC needs shift charts; AVAIL 'injur' mapped to goalie_games is wrong (skater role shifts need availability vintages).

nhl.toi_trend.rationale: CONTRACTS:cap ('floor/cap' of a projection) and PROJECTIONS:projection are spurious; EWMA TOI by state is computed from nhl.player_games toi_ev_s/toi_pp_s/toi_sh_s, EVENT_TIME.

nhl.goalie_pull_risk.rationale: Catalog flags pk=no but the input is a pregame probability model (per-goalie/coach pull rate, opp xGF, win prob): derived input; coach identity needed; the leakage verdict NOT_PREGAME_KNOWABLE misclassifies a model feature.

nhl.series_context.rationale: Series DP uses injury-adjusted win probabilities: AVAIL 'injur' was mapped to goalie_games and LINEUP to blocked shifts; need injury/lineup vintages (LIVE_SNAPSHOT) and upstream ratings.

nhl.sos_remaining.rationale: PLAYER_BOX:points per is spurious (points per game of teams); the input is derived from team ratings plus tie-break rules.

nhl.award_voting_rules.rationale: NEWS:announce is spurious for a historical model fit (winners/finalists with stats); needs award result history and criteria text, not timestamped news.

nhl.career_trajectory.rationale: Age curves and rookie/sophomore ramp need birth date and NHL debut season; nhl.player_games has no age/birth fields (only position). Need a player biographical dataset.

nhl.joint_outcome_correlation.rationale: Measurement simulates latent pace, script and goalie variables then generates player stats: it is a simulation input built on nhl.pace, nhl.game_script_prob, nhl.goalie_quality and nhl.stat_dist, so its status must be capped by them.

nhl.scratch_void_risk.rationale: raw_data: Kalshi rules text DNP clause, lineup/injury vintages, historical scratch rates. Draft mapped LINEUP to shift charts and AVAIL 'dnp' to goalie_games (final); needs mkt.kalshi_rules and availability vintages.

nhl.announcement_calendar.rationale: AWARDS and DRAFT needs are spurious: only dates of scheduled league events are needed (calendar documents) plus historical transaction dates; no vintaged draft boards or voting results.

m.settlement_truth.rationale: Settled value and settlement timestamp live in Kalshi market objects, not in NHL results or rules text; draft omitted that dataset.

m.rules_text.rationale: EVENT:overtime is spurious; 'versioned' wording history is not preserved by the free API (registry: old-series text truncated/absent), so coverage is coarse.

m.lifecycle.rationale: AVAIL:status, EVENT:pitch, TEAM_BOX:record are spurious. Open/close/halt events come from Kalshi market metadata; postponements from the NHL schedule.

m.strike_hit_rates.rationale: PLAYER_BOX:hit and RULES:rule are spurious ('hit rates'); realized frequencies need settled markets plus NHL outcomes, not rulebook reading.

nhl.season_sim_distribution.rationale: NEWS:report is spurious (the word 'report' in 'report points and playoff distributions'). The measurement is a Monte Carlo from own xG ratings with goalie-state, regulation/OT split and tiebreaks: a derived input, not raw data.

nhl.third_period_equalizer_hazard.rationale: raw_data lists 'coach tenure' (hazard by team and coach) but draft mapped no coach/staff dataset; nhl.games/shots_xy hold no coach identity or hire/fire dates. Needs a coaching history dataset.

nhl.series_ot_count_dependence.rationale: Needs series back to 2005-06 but nhl.games starts 2008-10 (three seasons short); derived from reg_tie_model pregame probabilities.

nhl.ratings_script_distribution.rationale: raw_data is 'team xG ratings; goalie GSAx and starter probability; pull-time history; OT 3v3 rates': all outputs of other catalog inputs (xg_for/against, goalie_quality, goalie_start, empty_net, ot_3v3_rate); draft treated it as raw DATA_IN_HAND.

nhl.settlement_goal_pmf.rationale: Needs Kalshi settlement wording (regulation/OT/SO/EN) via mkt.kalshi_rules, not NHL rulebook; derived distribution.

nhl.lineup_impact_delta.rationale: raw_data lists 'projected lineups with vintage' (no AVAIL need in draft) and shift charts. Draft COLLECT_FREE_UNVERIFIED/PIT_SAFE ignores that vintages exist only from 2026-10.

nhl.prior_to_current_blend.rationale: raw_data needs 'age' and 'roster moves with TOI': nhl.player_games has no birth date/age field (only position), and the prior-season rating is the own nhl.ratings output. Draft marked DATA_IN_HAND from box data alone.

nhl.pp_termination_unit_split.rationale: raw_data needs penalty events with strength changes and unit assignment by shift: nhl.shots_xy contains shot events only (no penalty/expiry events) and shift charts (nhl.shifts_lines) are FREE_BLOCKED_FROM_RUNNER.

nhl.goalie_minutes_in_net_dist.rationale: Needs starter confirmation (goalie_games starter flag is final-only) and depends on the start-probability input.

nhl.arena_sog_recording_factor.rationale: Team-game SOG is not in team_states (seconds only) or games (scores); must come from player_games sog or shots_xy.

nhl.ot_shot_exposure.rationale: RULES:regulation is spurious: 'regulation tie probability' is the own reg_tie_model output, not rulebook text. Shot exposure is built on 3v3 OT shots from nhl.shots_xy and depends on nhl.reg_tie_model; the needless reference-document need forced COLLECT_FREE_UNVERIFIED.

nhl.period_penalty_intensity_balance.rationale: raw_data needs penalty events with period and time: nhl.shots_xy has only shot events and player_games only pim totals, so EVENT->shots_xy is the wrong dataset; crew assignments remain NO_FREE_SOURCE.

nhl.rest_fatigue_period_profile.rationale: WEATHER_FCST:forecast is spurious: 'start forecast' is the goalie start-probability model; derived from goalie_start_forecast.

nhl.ipp_by_state.rationale: Points-by-strength needs scorer and assister per goal by strength: nhl.player_games a1/a2 are game totals not split by EV/PP (only on-ice gf_ev/gf_pp and pp_goals), and shots_xy has no assister field; needs NHL play-by-play goal events.

nhl.onice_xgf_per60.rationale: raw_data starts with 'shift charts' (nhl.shifts_lines, FREE_BLOCKED_FROM_RUNNER) and zone starts (faceoff events absent from shots_xy); RAPM adjustment needs on-ice player identity per shot. DATA_IN_HAND is wrong.

nhl.first_goal_scorer_share.rationale: AVAIL 'starting goalie' mapped to goalie_games (final starter flag); needs nhl.lineup_goalie_pregame confirmation.

nhl.next_man_up_redistribution.rationale: raw_data lists TOI by line and PP unit (shift charts, blocked) and 'game absence lists' = pregame availability; draft mapped only blocked LINEUP, no AVAIL vintages (nhl.injuries and lineup_goalie_pregame start 2026-10).

nhl.early_window_goal_rate.rationale: raw_data says 'confirmed starters': AVAIL was mapped to nhl.goalie_games whose starter flag is FINAL_ONLY (no confirmation time); a pregame confirmed starter exists only in nhl.lineup_goalie_pregame (2026-10 onward, LIVE_SNAPSHOT).

nhl.skater_ot_3v3_exposure.rationale: RULES:regulation is spurious ('regulation tie probability' is the own reg_tie_model). OT TOI per skater is in nhl.player_games toi_ot_s; the input depends on nhl.reg_tie_model.

nhl.games_played_hazard.rationale: AVAIL 'injur' mapped to goalie_games; skater injury vintages exist only in nhl.injuries; age needs a bio table; EVENT:hazard spurious.

nhl.player_season_points_projection.rationale: PROJECTIONS:projection is spurious (own rate x games-played model, not an external projection vintage). raw_data lists games-played hazard and PP assignments: depends on nhl.games_played_hazard/pp_role/ipp_by_state; PP assignment needs shift charts (blocked).

nhl.shot_share_reallocation.rationale: raw_data: shift charts (nhl.shifts_lines, blocked) and 'lineup absences', i.e. pregame availability, which draft did not map (nhl.injuries/lineup_goalie_pregame prospective only).

nhl.pair_difference_distribution.rationale: Catalog labels it '[Model output, not raw data]': depends on nhl.stat_dist, nhl.lines and nhl.toi; line/pairing membership needs shift charts (draft LINEUP->blocked, status capped by upstream).

nhl.teammate_point_co_credit.rationale: Needs goal events with scorer AND assisters plus pair line TOI: player_games a1/a2 are per-player totals, not scorer-assister pairs, and line membership needs shift charts (blocked). DATA_IN_HAND from player_games/team_states alone is wrong.

nhl.goal_credit_allocation_kernel.rationale: raw_data requires on-ice skaters for each goal with assisters and strength: shots_xy has only the shooter and goalie, player_games has no on-ice linkage, so shift charts (blocked) plus pbp goal events are needed.

nhl.lineup_scenario_tree.rationale: raw_data: goalie rotation, injury report vintages, lineup confirmations. Draft mapped AVAIL to goalie_games (FINAL_ONLY, goalies only) and LINEUP to blocked shifts; vintages exist only in nhl.injuries/lineup_goalie_pregame (2026-10+). Scenario model depends on start forecast and injuries inputs.

nhl.parlay_leg_void_payoff_map.rationale: AVAIL:status is spurious ('leg status vectors' are market outcomes). raw_data is Kalshi rules_primary text per combo series: mkt.kalshi_rules (FREE_REACHABLE, STATIC); AVAIL mapped to goalie_games was making the pit verdict LEAKY.

nhl.leg_logical_relations.rationale: PLAYER_BOX:share is spurious (matched 'shared ladders'); raw_data is Kalshi rules_primary/secondary and ladder structure metadata = mkt.kalshi_rules, which is static and measured reachable.

nhl.rating_posterior_uncertainty.rationale: Game xG is in nhl.shots_xy (MoneyPuck xGoal), not team_states (seconds by strength only); the posterior is the nhl.ratings model output plus preseason prior, so derived.

nhl.loser_point_rate.rationale: MARKET_RULES:resolution is spurious (label's 'OT-resolution rate'); results by RW/OTW/SOW/OTL come from nhl.games (last_period_type, scores) and need no Kalshi rules.

nhl.bracket_path_difficulty.rationale: MARKET_RULES:rules text is spurious (raw_data 'format rules text' = NHL playoff format, covered by RULES). Division/conference membership by season needs reference tables; remaining-schedule simulation depends on rating/standings inputs.

nhl.cap_flexibility_deadline.rationale: VENUE:capacity (cap capacity) and PLAYER_BOX:hit (cap hit) are spurious. Needs daily cap-hit snapshots, LTIR and pick inventory; xx.contracts_finance says as-of vintages are not preserved, so only capture from nhl.transactions_draft.

nhl.goalie_award_projection.rationale: PROJECTIONS:projection is spurious (own Vezina projection). Derived from nhl.goalie_quality (GSAx), nhl.award_stats and starts share (nhl.goalie_start); needs Vezina finalist history from nhl.awards.

nhl.rookie_role_pedigree.rationale: raw_data needs 'prior-league stats' (CHL/NCAA/Europe), absent from every registry dataset (player_games is NHL only) and the PP unit (shift charts, blocked); RULES:slot spurious (draft slot).

nhl.coach_expectation_delta.rationale: raw_data lists coach start dates and Jack Adams finalists/winners: no coach dataset or awards need was mapped; man-games lost to key players needs injury history. 'In-house preseason expectation' is own model output.

nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing.rationale: CONTRACTS:cap is spurious (lottery 'move-up cap' = rule); official odds per seed since 2016 are rules text (RULES); simulated standings come from nhl.ratings and ownership from the pick-ownership input.

nhl.pick_ownership_and_protection.rationale: WEATHER_OBS:conditions (protection conditions) and TEAM_BOX:team are spurious keyword hits; raw need is a vintaged pick table from PuckPedia/CapWages, which is LIVE_SNAPSHOT.

nhl.prospect_consensus_ranking.rationale: AVAIL:injur and TEAM_BOX:team are spurious. Ranking history is needed; nhl.transactions_draft states 'ranking vintages not archived', so xx.draft_boards_vintaged (Wayback/captures) is the right dataset.

nhl.player_contract_status_clauses.rationale: AVAIL:status was mapped to nhl.goalie_games (goalie rows) and PLAYER_BOX:player is incidental. Contract clauses need CONTRACTS tables; as-of vintages are not preserved (xx.contracts_finance).

nhl.suitor_cap_and_roster_fit.rationale: LINEUP:depth chart was mapped to blocked shift charts, but a depth chart is roster composition available from nhl.player_games by season/team; cap space needs contract snapshots.

nhl.expansion_governance_gates.rationale: raw_data is Board of Governors dates, timestamped press releases and commissioner statements: xx.news_timestamped is the right dataset; nhl.transactions_draft covers transactions/draft/contracts only.

nhl.insider_report_credibility.rationale: raw_data is 'timestamped insider posts with type and wording': needs xx.news_timestamped (no free structured archive), with official transaction dates as the comparison set.

nhl.reference_class_hazard.rationale: EVENT:hazard and PLAYER_BOX:player are spurious; raw_data names transaction history, expansion process timeline and award finalist sets: needs awards history and timestamped press releases.

nhl.win_streak_extremum_dist.rationale: Catalog says '[Simulation output, not raw data]': depends on nhl.ratings and nhl.rating_posterior_uncertainty plus game-result sequence; TEAM_BOX:rating is the own rating model.

nhl.league_scoring_environment.rationale: raw_data lists 'PP opportunities per game': counts of penalties are not in team_states (seconds in PP only) or shots_xy; needs pbp penalty events.

nhl.schedule_sequence_profile.rationale: raw_data uses the 'team ratings posterior' (own nhl.ratings/nhl.rating_posterior_uncertainty output), so derived; VENUE need for travel/home stands is fine.

nhl.team_season_points_distribution.rationale: raw_data includes 'rating posterior' and tie-break rules: derived from nhl.ratings, nhl.rating_posterior_uncertainty, nhl.standings_tiebreakers and nhl.loser_point_rate.

nhl.national_team_roster_strength.rationale: raw_data needs tournament rosters and lines and international TOI history, absent from the registry (NHL-only data), and 3-season RAPM which needs shift charts (blocked). Draft DATA_IN_HAND is optimistic.

nhl.short_tournament_format_sim.rationale: Format simulation built on nhl.national_team_roster_strength; derived; tournament rules text needs RULES reference.

nhl.playoff_round_goal_leader_sim.rationale: Catalog is a simulation (series length x per-game goal rates): built from shot_rate, ixg_player, goalie_quality, toi and series_game_count_pmf; draft treated it as raw.

nhl.retirement_hazard_profile.rationale: AVAIL:injur mapped to nhl.goalie_games is wrong; needs age (no birth date in player_games), contract end dates, injuries games missed (nhl.injuries live-only) and retirement announcements.

nhl.gm_candidate_pool.rationale: raw_data needs vacancy/hire dates, candidate names from timestamped reports and executive history: xx.news_timestamped plus a front-office history dataset, not nhl.transactions_draft.

nhl.draft_board_dispersion.rationale: raw_data: service ranks by prospect and publication date and Wayback capture timestamps = xx.draft_boards_vintaged; nhl.transactions_draft says ranking vintages not archived.

nhl.draft_pick_trade_hazard.rationale: RULES:slot is spurious (draft slot); needs GM tenure (no staff dataset mapped), pick trade history and points pct at trade date.

nhl.prospect_eligibility_medical_flags.rationale: AVAIL:injur mapped to nhl.goalie_games is wrong for prospects (not NHL goalies); needs prospect birthdates, games missed, combine medical reports; PLAYER_BOX:share is spurious.

nhl.gm_draft_behavior_history.rationale: RULES:slot is spurious (pick slot); raw_data needs GM and scouting-director tenures (no staff dataset) and historical consensus ranks (vintaged boards).

nhl.draft_remaining_board_state.rationale: Catalog says '[Model state, joint simulation]': built on consensus ranking, dispersion, club picks history, lottery and production inputs; AVAIL:availab is spurious ('prospects still available').

nhl.prospect_production_profile.rationale: raw_data is prospect league stats by age, NHLe translations and combine results; PLAYER_BOX:stats mapped to nhl.player_games (NHL only) cannot supply prior-league data.

nhl.series_game_count_pmf.rationale: Catalog says '[Model output, not raw data]' built from per-game probabilities; AVAIL:injur mapped to goalie_games is wrong for goalie/injury states (vintages exist 2026-10+).

nhl.series_state_scoring_shift.rationale: VENUE:venue is spurious (home flag comes from nhl.games); forced COLLECT_FREE_UNVERIFIED via unprobed venue_geo. 'team rating mean' is the own nhl.ratings output.

nhl.series_adjustment_regime.rationale: raw_data lists 'coach tenures' with no coach dataset mapped (nhl.games/player_games have no coach identity); DATA_IN_HAND overstated.

nhl.series_game_dependence.rationale: raw_data uses 'pre-series ratings', the own nhl.ratings output: derived input; game outcomes with order come from nhl.games.

nhl.series_state_win_prob_shift.rationale: raw_data requires playoff game results since 1987 with series state, but nhl.games starts 2008-10 (21 seasons short); needs a long playoff-results history; pre-game ratings are own model output.

nhl.series_pair_scoring_rate_uncertainty.rationale: DRAFT:combine ('combined goal rate') and PLAYER_BOX:share are spurious; raw_data is team goals and xG, rating posterior draws and league scoring multiplier from other inputs.

new_datasets.title: NHL play-by-play non-shot events: penalties, faceoffs with zone, goal assisters, strength changes
new_datasets.missingness: not in the pulled archive: nhl_shots holds shot events only; team_states holds only seconds by strength; player_games holds pim and a1/a2 totals

new_datasets.title: Player biographical reference: birth date, debut season, draft year, position
new_datasets.missingness: nhl_player_games has no birth date or age column

new_datasets.title: Head coach, GM and scouting-director tenures with start and end dates
new_datasets.freshness: updated on each hire or firing
new_datasets.missingness: not in pulled data; tenure dates must be scraped and encoded

Best-on-best tournament rosters, lines and international TOI history
new_datasets.missingness: no registry dataset holds tournament rosters; requires manual encoding

registry_objections.objection: Ledger columns include a1/a2 totals and on-ice gf/ga/sog/att by state, but no strength-split assists, no linemate/line, no zone-start or penalty-event fields; the title 'EV/PP/SH splits and TOI' should not be read as line or event coverage.

Ledger columns (shooter_id, kind, x, y, strength, zone, goalie_in_net_id) are shot events only; xG comes from the MoneyPuck table, whose 2008-2020 extension is 'reachable' rather than collected, so first=2021 understates available xG history, yet it holds no penalties, faceoffs or on-ice skaters.
